verdict.rationale: Crossplane is a Kubernetes-based infrastructure control plane that exposes declarative APIs for humans, automation and AI agents to act on. It is not an AI agent or tool-consuming client, so plugging MCP servers into it to use their tools is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes AI agents only as consumers of Crossplane's APIs, which is the opposite direction, and shows no MCP-client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
